query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T16:39:58Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T16:49:58Z"
        AND host.name == "canary-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, source.port, user.name, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 1000
